name: TuneBot
tagline: A questioning coach for the reflexes you fall into when someone else succeeds
description: A conversational investigator of human behaviour, built on Tuning Theory. It helps you understand a pattern you keep repeating, what keeps it going, and what else you could learn to do, then gives you one small, reversible experiment to try.
author: steinolina
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
